title: Square Enix warns that the remakes of Final Fantasy VI, VIII or IX could be much longer than the FFVII trilogy
summary: Company developers point out that adapting these classic games to current standards could require four or five installments to cover their entire story, which has sparked debate among fans.

title: Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls concludes its beta with Blade and Magik as most used characters and criticism for PC performance
summary: The open beta of the fighting game attracted more than 33,000 players on Steam, but performance issues forced the developer to apologize to the community.

title: Xbox suffers a 15-hour global outage that prevents gaming, Microsoft blames a single service failure and promises solutions
summary: A failure in a single technical component left millions of users without access to their games, even physical ones, for over half a day; the company apologized and detailed measures to prevent it from happening again.

title: STALKER 2: Heart of Chornobyl receives 'Cost of Hope', its first major expansion, on August 20
summary: GSC Game World announces the game's first downloadable content, which will add new missions, areas, and challenges in the Zone.

title: Cyan reveals a canceled prototype for a new Myst and confirms that another title in the saga is in development
summary: The studio Cyan Worlds shows for the first time an abandoned project from the Myst series, while ensuring that a different game in the franchise is still in production.

title: Halo: Campaign Evolved is now available for Xbox with updated graphics and cultural controversy
summary: The remake of the original Halo campaign arrives on Xbox, acclaimed for its technical aspect, though some narrative changes have sparked controversy among fans.

title: PlayStation fans organize a one-week blackout against the elimination of physical discs
summary: The PlayStation community plans a seven-day boycott to protest Sony's strategy of abandoning physical format on its consoles.

title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day hits theaters with mixed reviews and multiple updates on its plot and video game
summary: Reviews of the new Spider-Man movie are mixed; the post-credits scene, the character played by Sadie Sink, and the arrival of new suits in Marvel's Spider-Man 2 are confirmed.

title: Capcom increases its quarterly earnings by 81% driven by Pragmata and Resident Evil
summary: First quarter financial results show strong growth thanks to the launch of Pragmata and the performance of the Resident Evil franchise, along with sales records for Monster Hunter and Street Fighter.

title: Shigeru Miyamoto shares his design philosophy and current gaming habits
summary: The creator of Super Mario and Zelda talks about his approach of not following trends, his opinion on console technical specifications, and the games he plays in his free time.

title: Ubisoft gives away 13 games on PC to users who own them on Xbox
summary: Thanks to an agreement with Microsoft, players who own Ubisoft titles on Xbox can download them for free on PC, including franchises like Assassin's Creed and Far Cry.

title: Capcom plans to release a Resident Evil game every year to maintain the series' pace
summary: The Japanese company confirms its intention to publish annual installments of Resident Evil, relying on remakes to meet the schedule.

title: Rockstar co-founder speaks in favor of companies continuing to offer physical games
summary: The co-founder of Rockstar Games believes that publishers should provide physical options for players who prefer them, amid the debate over the digital rise.

title: Call of Duty: Black Ops 2 players beg for the constant voting of Nuketown, Hijacked and Raid to stop
summary: The community complains that the constant repetition of these maps makes the gaming experience monotonous and frustrating.

title: Nioh 3 releases its first DLC 'Hell Rising' in August with new weapons and extreme difficulty mode
summary: The expansion will take players to a futuristic setting in the Keian era, with new mechanics and an additional challenge for the most hardcore.

title: Former Dragon Age director calls EA a 'hedge fund with a hobby for video games' and believes the series is dead
summary: The original executive producer of Dragon Age criticizes Electronic Arts' corporate strategy and assures that the franchise will not rise again under that management.

title: The Pokémon Company will use facial recognition to stop card scalpers
summary: To avoid speculation and resale of Pokémon products, the company will implement a biometric verification system in stores.

title: Splatoon Raiders is crowned as one of the best user-rated games on Metacritic
summary: Nintendo's action title has achieved exceptionally high user scores, placing it in the top 10 of the best-rated games on the platform.

title: Physical copies of GTA 6 in Japan will expire after 170 days if the code is not redeemed
summary: Rockstar Games sets a time limit to redeem codes for physical versions of Grand Theft Auto VI in Japan, which has generated complaints among consumers.

title: Indie developer discovers that his forgotten game on Steam is being used for an Undertale multiplayer mod
summary: After a 1700% increase in activity on his game, the developer realizes that his title is being used as a base for an unofficial Undertale mod, to his surprise.

title: The young actor who will play Link couldn't play Breath of the Wild because of his age and lack of console
summary: Benjamin Evan Ainsworth, 11, reveals that when the game was released he was only eight years old and did not own a Nintendo Switch, so he could only watch videos of other players.

title: The original 1998 Pokémon presentation in the US that explained the keys to its success is revealed
summary: A historic video shows how Nintendo of America planned the launch of Pokémon in the West, revealing the strategy that turned the franchise into a worldwide phenomenon.
